message: COPY DB2STAT (line 35, FILE SECTION): DB2STAT is not in copybook_registry; the inventory lists it only as a program (src/programs/common/DB2STAT.cbl, SYS-PORTFOLIO-001-FIL-0057). Left as an unresolved copy stub; no USES_COPYBOOK or EXPANDS_COPY registered.

COPY DB2STAT (line 35) and COPY BCHCTL (line 36) sit directly in the FILE SECTION before any FD; BCHCTL contains no FD. SELECT DB2-STATS (line 17) and SELECT BATCH-STATS (line 23) therefore have no FD/record. The BCHCTL record is linked by EXPANDS_COPY from the FILE section (SYS-PORTFOLIO-001-FIL-0050-SEC-0002), not registered as a FILE record, and carries no fd_name.

RECORD KEY STAT-KEY (SELECT DB2-STATS, line 20) and RECORD KEY BCH-KEY (SELECT BATCH-STATS, line 26) are not declared in the program or in the expanded copybooks BCHCTL, RTNCODE, ERRHAND (DB2STAT is unresolved).
